input.hypothesis: Democrats take the House in the 2026 midterms

nodes.statement: US enters a significant economic downturn within 90 days
nodes.resolution: Real GDP growth turns negative for two consecutive quarters or unemployment rises above 6.5%
nodes.rationale: Economic conditions typically influence midterm voting patterns, with downturns historically hurting the party in power
assumptions: Economic indicators will be the primary voting issue
Voters hold the incumbent party responsible for economic conditions
Media coverage will emphasize economic struggles

nodes.statement: Major scandal or impeachment proceedings against Trump escalate within 90 days
nodes.resolution: House initiates impeachment inquiry or Trump faces indictment in a major case
nodes.rationale: Scandals involving prominent political figures can significantly impact voter sentiment and turnout
assumptions: Media coverage remains intense and sustained
nodes.marketQuery: DJT put/call ratio > 1.5 OR volatility index > 30

nodes.statement: Democratic voter mobilization efforts show measurable success in key districts
nodes.resolution: Voter registration drives result in 15%+ increase in new Democratic registrations in swing districts
nodes.rationale: Effective grassroots organizing can significantly impact turnout, especially in midterm elections
assumptions: Funding for mobilization efforts is secured
nodes.marketQuery: VotoLegal VTC +10% OR NGP VAN acquisition rumors

nodes.statement: Republican voter suppression controversies emerge in key states
nodes.resolution: Court cases or public revelations about voting restrictions gain national attention
nodes.rationale: Controversies around voting access can energize opposition voters and create backlash effects
assumptions: Democratic base responds with increased turnout
nodes.marketQuery: VotoLegal VTC +15% OR voting rights ETF activity

nodes.statement: Abortion rights become a dominant issue driving Democratic turnout
nodes.resolution: State-level abortion restrictions prompt federal legislative response or major court cases
nodes.rationale: Abortion rights have proven to be a strong motivator for Democratic voters, particularly in 2022
assumptions: Democratic messaging effectively frames the issue
Voters prioritize this over economic concerns
nodes.marketQuery: PLTR put/call ratio > 1.3 OR healthcare stock volatility

nodes.name: Swing District Polling Average
nodes.rationale: Aggregated polling in competitive House districts shows Democratic movement

nodes.name: Democratic Fundraising Advantage
nodes.rationale: Democratic fundraising outpaces Republicans, enabling more advertising and field operations

nodes.name: Youth Voter Turnout Projection
nodes.rationale: Young voter engagement metrics suggest higher than expected turnout
assumptions: Youth vote translates to Democratic votes

nodes.statement: Media coverage becomes more favorable to Democratic messaging
nodes.resolution: Major outlets shift editorial stance or increase coverage of Democratic priorities
nodes.rationale: Media framing can significantly influence public perception and voter priorities
nodes.marketQuery: NYT put/call ratio < 0.8 OR DIS stock stability

nodes.statement: International crisis diverts attention from domestic issues
nodes.resolution: Major geopolitical event reduces focus on domestic economic concerns
nodes.rationale: Foreign policy crises can shift voter attention away from issues that might hurt the incumbent party
nodes.marketQuery: ITX put/call ratio > 1.4 OR defense stock surge

nodes.statement: Democrats gain control of the House of Representatives in 2026 midterms
nodes.resolution: Democrats win net gain of 218+ seats or maintain majority if already held
nodes.rationale: Multiple converging factors could create conditions favorable to Democratic House gains in 2026
nodes.marketQuery: DMZ +5% OR volatility in key battleground state ETFs

edges.mechanism: Economic dissatisfaction drives voters to oppose the party controlling the presidency
assumptions: Voters punish incumbents for economic conditions

edges.mechanism: Scandal fatigue and negative publicity reduce Republican voter enthusiasm
Abortion rights energize Democratic base and attract independent women voters
Grassroots organizing increases Democratic turnout in competitive districts
Voting restriction controversies create backlash that benefits Democrats
Favorable media coverage improves Democratic messaging effectiveness
International crisis shifts focus from domestic issues that might hurt Democrats
Positive polling trends in swing districts indicate viable path to House majority
Financial advantage enables superior advertising and field operations
assumptions: Spending priorities align with electoral needs
Coordination between national and local campaigns

edges.mechanism: Higher youth turnout benefits Democrats who perform better among younger voters
Economic downturn motivates donors to contribute more to Democratic candidates
assumptions: Competition for donations doesn't dilute effectiveness

edges.mechanism: Scandal coverage drives donor engagement and contributions to Democratic causes
assumptions: Donors view scandal as motivation to act
Competition for donations doesn't reduce overall effectiveness

edges.mechanism: Abortion rights issue drives significant donor contributions to Democratic campaigns
assumptions: Major donors align with grassroots priorities

edges.mechanism: Favorable media coverage amplifies abortion rights messaging effectiveness
International crisis negatively impacts domestic economic performance
Voting restriction controversies increase salience of reproductive rights issues
assumptions: Voters connect voting access to reproductive rights

summary.headline: Democratic path to House majority in 2026 depends on economic dissatisfaction, Trump-related scandals, and abortion rights mobilization
summary.mainUncertainty: Whether multiple favorable factors will converge sufficiently within the 90-day horizon to overcome structural disadvantages
followUps: Monitor real GDP and unemployment trends for economic downturn signals
Track Trump-related legal developments and media coverage intensity
Watch abortion rights legislation and state-level voting restriction controversies
Follow fundraising reports and youth voter engagement metrics
